title: Reconcile recovery requirements and preserve a baseline
delivery: Record one capability map separating backend/API evidence, frontend logic and missing UI; preserve a recoverable baseline and unrelated changes.
criteria: Map original UI criteria to future page tickets without treating backend acceptance as full feature completion. Reconcile stale historical-access and attachment wording against approved owner amendments.

title: Verify the completed backend/API
delivery: Demonstrate the complete MVP API using authenticated workflows, stable contracts and isolated PostgreSQL.
criteria: Record backend acceptance independently of issue closure or UI completion. Verify fresh migrations, permissions/isolation, retries, conflicts, relevant concurrency and required checks; identify unresolved operational gates.

title: Separate identity, session and account business logic
delivery: Expose presentation-independent login, onboarding, recovery, account administration, permission and session behavior.
criteria: Test successful and denied transitions, account/clinic switching and sensitive cache cleanup. Preserve existing API contracts and keep credentials out of logs/storage.

title: Separate patient, assignment and appointment business logic
delivery: Expose patient registration/search/archive, assignment/sharing and booking/status workflows without product UI.
criteria: Verify duplicate warnings, valid shared phones, authorized scopes, scheduling conflicts, retries and cache invalidation.

title: Separate clinical record and attachment business logic
delivery: Expose medical history, manual dental chart, historical views and authorized attachment operations without product UI.
criteria: Verify cutoff/revision selection, validation, quota feedback, denied access and recoverable input/error states.

title: Separate treatment plan and catalog business logic
delivery: Expose procedure catalog, proposals, versions, pricing, presentation, acceptance and revision behavior.
criteria: Verify accepted versions retain their values; changed scope/prices require renewed acceptance; surface conflict and permission states.

title: Separate visit, note and prescription business logic
delivery: Expose care progression, procedure completion, note autosave/finalization/corrections, prescriptions and authorized document operations.
criteria: Verify idempotent starts, stale conflicts, tab-memory drafts, explicit chart confirmation and prescription independence from medication references.

title: Separate billing business logic
delivery: Expose charges, opening balances, deposits, allocations, receipts, invoices, summaries and corrections through cohesive frontend workflow interfaces.
criteria: Verify distinct planned/due/credit and new-money/applied-credit states; explicit consequential actions, error/retry handling and server-authorized document access.

title: Separate inventory business logic
delivery: Expose item/supplier settings, receiving, batch availability, consumption and reasoned stock correction workflows.
criteria: Verify whole-pack validation, expiry/negative-stock errors, retry handling, authorized state and invalidation.

title: Separate report, follow-up and export business logic
delivery: Expose authorized operational reports, follow-up tasks, manual sharing and export lifecycle behavior.
criteria: Verify scope restrictions, reconciled totals, empty/failure states and no fabricated data. Record the frontend behavior-layer gate across R3–R10.

title: Build the Dentara shell, dashboard and authentication pages
delivery: After separate UI-stage authorization, deliver the approved responsive workspace, actual operational dashboard, sidebar/header and designed authentication/onboarding/recovery journeys.
criteria: Support direct links, refresh, back/forward, active navigation and denied/not-found states. Every visible destination works; omit unfinished destinations. Historical-only accounts do not enter active-care screens.

title: Build the patient list and profile pages
delivery: Deliver the dedicated searchable patient list and profile with registration, editing, archive/reactivation and patient navigation.
criteria: Connect established logic through components and pages; demonstrate duplicate warnings, valid shared contacts and role-specific behavior.

title: Build patient assignment and sharing workflows
delivery: Deliver understandable patient assignment, explicit sharing/removal and scope-aware navigation.
criteria: Verify denied direct navigation and permission changes do not expose unauthorized patient data or stale cached records.

title: Build medical history and dental chart pages
delivery: Deliver the patient clinical workspace, history/allergies, manual chart and essential retained history.
criteria: Verify assigned access, supported dentition/tooth/surface states, revision conflicts and clinically restricted views.

title: Build treatment proposal, version and acceptance pages
delivery: Deliver plan creation, procedure selection, pricing, presentation, acceptance, retained versions and revisions.
criteria: Demonstrate printable proposals, changed-scope acceptance and permission-controlled price changes using existing behavior interfaces.

title: Build appointment and arrival pages
delivery: Deliver the appointment workspace with booking/rescheduling, statuses, conflicts and walk-in arrival.
criteria: Demonstrate explicit authorized override and preserved history; bookings do not implicitly grant clinical access.

title: Build visit and clinical note pages
delivery: Deliver starting care, selecting/progressing procedures, visit completion and note drafting/finalization/corrections.
criteria: Demonstrate save/error/conflict states, retained tab-memory input, pending notes and independent procedure completion.

title: Build prescription and chart-confirmation workflows
delivery: Deliver manual prescribing, medication reference lookup, retained corrections, authorized printing and explicit chart-update confirmation.
criteria: Demonstrate manual entry during reference failure, preserved prescription text and doctor-only issuance where required.

title: Build patient attachment workflows
delivery: Deliver authorized upload/view, quota feedback, acceptance-evidence linking and reasoned logical removal.
criteria: Preserve existing-file access at quota, protected history and scope/format/size restrictions; use approved current quota contracts.

title: Build charges, deposits and settlement pages
delivery: Deliver the billing workspace with documented opening balances, planned/due separation, debt/credit, manual allocation and receipts.
criteria: Demonstrate new money versus existing credit, explicit deposits and safe consequential-action/retry states.

title: Build invoice, summary and financial correction pages
delivery: Deliver eligible invoice issue/reprints, whole-plan summaries and reasoned refund/reversal/credit workflows.
criteria: Preserve document identity/history; demonstrate settlement eligibility and distinct correction outcomes without automatic refunds.

title: Build inventory receiving and availability pages
delivery: Deliver item/supplier setup, whole-pack receiving, batch availability, low-stock thresholds and expiry settings.
criteria: Demonstrate real stock data, permissions, expiry boundaries and meaningful empty/error states.

title: Build inventory consumption and correction pages
delivery: Deliver batch selection, whole-pack consumption, waste/disposal, count corrections and retained movement history.
criteria: Demonstrate expired/negative-stock denial and explicit reasons without treatment-visit linkage.

title: Build report, follow-up and export pages
delivery: Deliver scoped operational reports, follow-up tasks, manual sharing and authorized export journeys.
criteria: Reconcile totals and authorization; expose true export state/failures, with no advanced BI or automatic delivery.

title: Build administration and reference catalog pages
delivery: Deliver staff accounts, permissions, clinic settings, recovery administration and procedure/medication reference management.
criteria: Demonstrate admin workflows without granting a non-doctor manager clinical access; catalog changes preserve patient records.

title: Build the restricted historical workspace
delivery: Deliver restricted historical login, permitted cutoff-bound clinical and own-work financial snapshots under the approved contracts, plus manager grant/revocation workflows.
criteria: Exclude later changes and unauthorized operational/edit/print/download/export actions. Apply current owner amendments, not superseded blanket wording.

title: Retire the scaffold and verify the connected application
delivery: Remove replaced scaffold presentation only after every required journey has a verified real-page replacement; retain/adapt useful tests and complete a fictional-data connected rehearsal.
criteria: Record all backend/logic/UI requirement coverage and residual gates. Supply evidence to existing #28/#29 without declaring restoration, deployment or real-patient acceptance complete.
